create_loader_and_network: create a RoIDataLoader and Caffe2 dequeue network from sample data for testing parallel data loading
run_net: run a Caffe2 network once and fetch the data blob from the GPU workspace
get_roidb_blobs: stack ROI database entries into a blob dictionary with stacked numpy data arrays

test_two_parallel_loaders: test that two parallel RoIDataLoader instances correctly serve independent data through separate networks
